title: E2 reminder seam: per-recipient continue-URL selection and list_resumable_draft_tokens SQL have no test
detail: Requirement 5 / acceptance 'reminder stage-2 carries the continue-link' is only half-covered: the builder arms are unit-tested, but the new SQL (WHERE submitted_at IS NULL AND continue_token IS NOT NULL) and the recipient→URL mapping are untested (grep server/test: zero references).
recommended_fix: Add an integration test pinning list_resumable_draft_tokens (excludes submitted/tokenless drafts), and extract the continue-url selection as a pure function with unit tests for hit/miss/empty-token.

title: Strip-on-submit hook in application_handler not covered through the real POST /apply path
detail: Acceptance 'resumed draft submits → draft stripped' is PARTIAL: the SQL primitive and the late-save race are integration-tested, but nothing proves the hook fires on a successful submit with the form's email. handle_post_form is already exercised in gdpr/application integration tests, so the gap is testable.
recommended_fix: Extend an existing successful handle_post_form integration test: seed a draft for (vacancy, applicant email), submit, assert fields='{}', token NULL, submitted_at set.

title: Resume GET on a closed vacancy (spec I/O matrix: 'existing closed page') has no test
detail: Drafts survive vacancy close until the daily retention sweep, so a continue-link click in that window hits this branch. The spec's frozen I/O matrix specifies the closed page; no test pins it (the save endpoint's closed branch is tested, the resume one is not).
recommended_fix: Add an integration test: seed draft+token on a closed vacancy, GET /apply/:code/resume/:token, assert closed-page render (not the pre-filled form).

title: resumed_at stamp-once (COALESCE) and submitted-guard boundaries unpinned
evidence:
UPDATE application_draft
SET resumed_at = COALESCE(resumed_at, now())
WHERE continue_token = $1
  AND vacancy_id = $2::uuid
  AND submitted_at IS NULL
RETURNING id::text;
detail: The integration test pins only the first stamp. A regression dropping COALESCE (second save moves resumed_at, corrupting the resume funnel) or the submitted_at IS NULL guard would pass all tests. The frozen matrix's 'resumed_at set once' is unverified.
recommended_fix: Extend first_post_resume_save_stamps_resumed_at_test: capture resumed_at, save again with the token, assert unchanged; optionally assert a stripped draft never stamps.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
- Full journey works: start form → leave → magic link → state restored → submit; draft expiry + erasure verified; no file data in the draft table (schema-verifiable); reminder stage-2 carries the continue-link.
- `make test` and `make test-integration` (docker test DB) green; new behavior covered (draft round-trip, token auth on the link, expiry sweep, erasure).
detail: P0 100% (token no-leak: uniform 404/404-cross-vacancy/404-after-submit/200-cooldown all pinned; CSRF-skip arms pinned; filter pins no-consent/no-internals). P1 ≈85%: save/continue-link/resume/erasure/expiry/no-docs FULL; strip-on-submit and E2 seam PARTIAL (wiring untested). Overall ≈90% ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Cover the strip-on-submit hook end-to-end and the stage-2 continue-URL selection + list_resumable_draft_tokens SQL; that lifts P1 past 90% for PASS.
